configurations.//: `scripts/dev-alt.mjs` rather than `npm run dev`, because a port is not enough: Next 16 locks `<distDir>/dev/lock`, so a second dev server on this checkout is refused on ANY port. The launcher gives this one its own distDir as well as its own port. package.json's `dev` script and dev.cmd stay on 5054 and `.next` — that window prints 127.0.0.1:5054 and is where the browser testing happens; a harness-side conflict is not a reason to move it.
configurations.//port: Stated twice — the argument is what Next binds, `port` is where the harness connects — so `autoPort` stays false and a collision is fixed by changing both numbers here.
configurations.name: dev

configurations.//: A SECOND harness dev server, for when another chat is already holding `dev`. Same launcher, its own port and its own distDir, so the two do not contend for Next's `<distDir>/dev/lock`. Added rather than renumbering `dev`: the chat holding 5057 is connected to it, and moving that entry would drop them.
configurations.name: dev-b

configurations.//: The static export served by the Cloudflare Pages emulator, WITH the /api functions and a local D1. `npm run dev` above has no /api at all, so the upload path can only be exercised here. Run `npm run build` first — this serves out/, it does not create it.
configurations.//port: Stated TWICE and the two must stay in step: `runtimeArgs` is what wrangler binds, `port` is where the harness connects. That is also why `autoPort` stays false — letting the harness pick a free port would only change the second one, and it would then wait on a port wrangler never bound. Moved off 8788 because another chat's preview was already holding it; on a collision, change both numbers here rather than the flag.
configurations.name: preview
